# History

## 60 Years and Counting

ICPSR (Inter-university Consortium for Political and Social Research) was founded in 1962 by political scientist Warren E. Miller to share scientific data. Before this, scientific data from all disciplines were closely held by their developers and creators. Since then, ICPSR has expanded the impact of social and behavioral research, acting as a global leader in data stewardship and providing rich data resources and responsive educational opportunities for the research data community.
